name: officina-claude
description: Session handoffs, token metrics, live plan co-design, offline diagrams and behaviour-driven scenario matrices for Claude Code.

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Interview-first idea refinement (/refine) and session handoff notes that let /clear replace /compact (/handoff), with the pivot gate that checks each note against the work item's intent file.

plugins.name: token-hygiene
plugins.description: Per-session token metrics and /token-dashboard to chart them, plus guards that keep the context small: read caps, re-read dedup, long-output squashing and a watchdog that interrupts once the context passes 150k tokens.

plugins.name: planner-companion
plugins.description: Co-design a plan with Claude on a live local web page: decisions, diagrams and tasks, with sequence, workflow and ERD diagrams drawn offline.

plugins.name: diagrams
plugins.description: Sequence, workflow and entity-relationship diagrams from compact rows, rendered offline to static SVG with no dependencies.

plugins.name: scenario-matrix
plugins.description: Behaviour-driven scenario matrices with an installable Node harness: setup installs the core and the adapters a project's stack needs, matrix builds and compiles the matrix, run runs it.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Project knowledge base in atomic YAML rules: a session digest, rules injected and checked at edit time, a /kb capture queue curated by a scribe agent, and a setup that seeds it from Claude memory and instruction files.
